title: Exact Minimum $d$-Degree Thresholds for Hypergraph Perfect Matchings
summary: For fixed integers $k\ge3$ and $1\le d\le k-1$ and sufficiently large $n\in k\mathbb N$, we establish the sharp minimum $d$-degree thresholds that forces perfect matching in every $n$-vertex $k$-uniform hypergraphs. This was conjectued by Treglown and Zhao, and the $d=1$ case was conjectued by Kühn, Osthus and Treglown.
